parts.text: How far away are the top 5 major NYC tourist attractions from the Waldorf Astoria New York hotel? Show me all the routes to each of these locations from the Waldorf Astoria Hotel in New York.

components.text:
The **Waldorf Astoria New York** is centrally located in Midtown Manhattan, making it an ideal base for exploring the city's most iconic landmarks. 

Below are the top 5 tourist attractions, their approximate travel distances from the hotel, and the best routes to reach them.

### **1. Top of The Rock**
**Distance:** ~0.5 miles (880m)
**Travel Time:** ~5 mins drive / 10 mins walk

Located at Rockefeller Center, this observation deck is just a short stroll or quick ride west of the hotel. It offers some of the best views of Central Park and the Empire State Building.

### **2. Times Square**
**Distance:** ~0.7 miles (1.1km)
**Travel Time:** ~6 mins drive / 15 mins walk

The 'Center of the Universe' is located just a few blocks southwest. The route typically takes you across 50th or 49th Street to the bright lights of Broadway.

### **3. Empire State Building**
**Distance:** ~1.0 mile (1.6km)
**Travel Time:** ~8 mins drive / 20 mins walk

Heading south on 5th Avenue or Park Avenue brings you to this Art Deco masterpiece. It's a iconic part of the skyline and offers high-altitude views of the entire city.

### **4. One World Observatory**
**Distance:** ~6.6 miles (10.6km)
**Travel Time:** ~25 mins drive

Located at the World Trade Center site in Lower Manhattan, this is a longer trip south. The route usually involves driving down the FDR Drive or through the West Side Highway.

### **5. Statue of Liberty**
**Distance:** ~6.1 miles (9.8km) to Battery Park Ferry
**Travel Time:** ~25 mins drive to the ferry terminal

To see the Statue of Liberty, you'll need to travel to the southern tip of Manhattan (Battery Park) to catch a ferry. The drive takes you through the heart of the Financial District.
